claims.claim_text: Contemporary professional and broadcasting directories support a high-confidence identification of indexed Hilton Remley as radio engineer Hilton L. Remley.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A rare full name with middle initial appears in a 1937 engineering directory and a 1946 WGN engineering chart; a 1944 WGN roster lists Hilton Remley as an Army private.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence match from the distinctive name, compatible Army enlisted status, and a continuous radio-engineering chronology across three contemporary sources.
claims.temporal_assessment: The sources span 1937, wartime 1944, and postwar 1946; they support identity and employment chronology without establishing the date of OSS transfer.
claims.match_notes: The 1946 title is not back-projected into the prewar period.

sources.locator_override: PDF page 8; Engineering Department organization chart

claims.claim_text: Hilton L. Remley worked as a meterman for New Mexico Power Company in Santa Fe in 1937.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Meterman, New Mexico Power Company, Santa Fe, N.M.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The 1937 Institute of Radio Engineers directory names Remley's job, employer, and city.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence identity from the distinctive full name with middle initial and corroborating later WGN sources.
claims.temporal_assessment: Explicitly documented in 1937, well before OSS service, but later WGN evidence means it is not the last known civilian employer.
claims.match_notes: The historical employer name is preserved; no successor company is inferred.

claims.claim_text: WGN is Hilton Remley's best-supported last civilian employer before Army service.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A 1944 broadcasting directory associates Hilton Remley with WGN while identifying him as an Army private.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence identity from the distinctive name and independent 1937 and 1946 engineering-directory corroboration.
claims.temporal_assessment: Probable immediate civilian predecessor to Army service; the roster does not state exact employment or enlistment dates.
claims.match_notes: The claim is visibly qualified and is not treated as an immediate pre-OSS affiliation.

sources.locator_override: PDF page 8; postwar Engineering Department organization chart

claims.claim_text: Institutional archival and scholarly sources support a high-confidence identification of indexed Captain Anker Rentse as the colonial administrator and military intelligence officer.
claims.evidence_excerpt: colonial administrator and military intelligence officer
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The UK National Archives finding aid identifies Rentse's papers and intelligence role; the scholarly chronology supplies the distinctive Malaya career.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence match from a rare exact name, compatible captaincy and military-intelligence description, and a detailed Kelantan chronology.
claims.temporal_assessment: The sources establish a prewar-to-wartime career but do not directly date Rentse's OSS entry.
claims.match_notes: No inference is made from his postwar civil-affairs position to the pre-OSS period.

claims.claim_text: Anker Rentse's last documented civilian employer before wartime displacement was the Kelantan Government.
claims.evidence_excerpt: officer of the Kelantan Government until the Japanese invasion
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The scholarly chronology places Rentse in Kelantan Government service until the Japanese invasion, followed by Singapore and Australia.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence identity from the rare exact name, archival finding aid, and compatible military-intelligence chronology.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded as the last named civilian role before wartime displacement; the immediate pre-OSS step remains unestablished.
claims.match_notes: Earlier work on unnamed plantation estates is not converted into a named employer claim.

claims.claim_text: The index prints separate TOMMIE I RAMMAGE and TOMMIE I REMMAGE rows with the same protected identifier; the records remain separate and conflicting.
claims.evidence_excerpt: RAMMAGE, TOMMIE I.; REMMAGE, TOMMIE I.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The two official index rows have different surnames and boxes but share the same private service identifier.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Conflicting; same identifier is strong duplication evidence, but the spelling and box differences require personnel-file comparison before any merge.
claims.temporal_assessment: The index conflict establishes no pre-OSS employer or chronological relationship.
claims.match_notes: Neither spelling is privileged, and neither entity is merged into the other.
